reviews.comment: His lectures are sometimes boring because it feels like the same material over and over again, but overall easy class. He lets you "contract" for an A or B so basically you get to pick how much work you want to put into the class. Tests are open-book but timed and lots of short answer questions. Cold calls on students in class so be prepared.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria
